Compose a complete example

This paragraph shows automatic wrapping for longer prose in a useful
commit message body.

This is a second paragraph with its own blank-line separation.

    Keep this literal detail exactly on one line even when it is far too long for normal commit prose.

Change-ID: I9f123456789012345678901234567890123456789

+-----------+---------+
| Component | Result  |
+-----------+---------+
| cache     | updated |
| worker    | waiting |
+-----------+---------+

1. Refresh the cache
  * Keep readers on the old version until validation completes
2. Publish the new generation

See [#1] for the validation rationale.

[#1] Validation prevents readers from observing a partially updated
     cache entry.
